parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.82 indicates structurally near-duplicate test methods (`calculatesAvgShaderFPS` at line 319 and `calculatesWorkloadReduction` at line 427), each test exercises a distinct metric concept — average shader FPS versus workload reduction — and their structural resemblance is characteristic of the arrange-act-assert pattern common to unit tests rather than accidental duplication. Merging or extracting these test bodies into shared helpers risks obscuring test intent and coupling unrelated metric assertions, which is the canonical test-fixture restraint pattern.
